model: SCF Series drive with Modbus module (basic network control)
applies_to: Lenze AC Tech SCF Series drives with the optional Modbus RTU communication module; application note AN0028/A1 (January 2008).
summary: The SCF is a Lenze AC Tech drive. With its Modbus option it can be started, stopped, reversed and speed-controlled over Modbus RTU at 9600 baud. This map holds the basic control registers from Lenze's quick-start note plus the rule that maps every SCF parameter to a Modbus register.

addressing.note: The note gives 4xxxx Modbus register numbers, which are AC Tech register + 1 (control register 1 = 40002). Wire address = Modbus register - 40001, so the control register is address 1. SCF parameter Pn is Modbus register n + 51 (P19 -> 40070).

source.title: Application Note: Basic Network Control of the SCF Drive using ModBus Communications

notes: Host: copy hosted by Precision Electric (a Lenze AC Tech distributor); no current copy was found on lenze.com.

This is a quick-start map only. The full register list is in the SCF ModBus Reference Guide RG-SFMOD, which was not available; other parameters follow 'Modbus register = parameter + 51' with scaling from the SCF manual.
Only 9600 baud is supported. Data format is chosen with P15: 02/03 = 8N2, 04/05 = 8E1, 06/07 = 8O1 (even numbers enable the 10 s watchdog).
Only one command bit per write to the control register.

integration.summary: Set P14 = 01 and P43 = address, write 0 (or the password) to 40049 once after power-up, then write 0008h to 40002 to start and the speed in 0.1 Hz to 40041 (with P05 = 01). Read 40027 for the run status.
integration.enable: P14 = 01 enables serial communication; P43 sets the address (1-247); P15 sets data format and watchdog.
integration.watchdog: Fixed 10 s: if enabled via P15 and the master stops communicating while the drive is under network control, the drive stops.
quirks: Use FC06, or FC16 with a length of 1, for every write.
The local STOP circuit stays active: input 1 (TB1 to TB2) must be asserted to start.
setup: Master at 9600 baud with the data format matching P15.
gotchas: Lenze advises not to leave the slave at address 1 to avoid duplicates.

registers.name: Drive control (AC Tech register 1)
registers.description: One command per write: 0004h stop, 0008h start, 0040h reverse, 0080h forward, 0200h manual.

registers.name: Status block start (AC Tech register 24)
registers.description: First of a 6-register status block; read 6 registers from here.

registers.name: Run status (AC Tech register 26, low byte)
registers.description: Low byte = operational status code; see values.

registers.name: Unlock (AC Tech register 48)
registers.description: 0 unlocks control only; password (default 225) also unlocks parameters.

registers.name: P19 acceleration time
registers.description: Example of the parameter rule: register = parameter + 51.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
